note: Accepted violations at this URPX revision. Compared as SETS, not counts: a count is invariant under one violation being traded for another, which is what a migration produces. Per-file mode is excluded because its keys are not comparable. The 'cross-filing-iri-reuse' triage counts focus nodes asserted in more than one file. What that means changed once subordinate @ids were scoped to their owning version: it no longer covers one descriptor minted by several schedules (dev/lint_iri_scope.py now refuses that outright), and every remaining key is a node DEFINED twice, which is a different defect tracked separately.
